_comment: VA Form 40-1330M — VA40-1330M Headstone/Marker Request — Error Messages
_status: draft — all messages must be reviewed by VA plain language team and NCA program office before launch

serviceStatusAtDeath.required: Select the service member's status at the time of death to continue.

guardReserveQualifyingCircumstance.required: Select the qualifying circumstance that applies to this service member to continue.

applicantFirstName.pattern: Your first name can only include letters, hyphens, apostrophes, and spaces.
applicantFirstName.maxlength: Your first name must be 30 characters or fewer.

applicantMiddleName.pattern: Your middle name can only include letters, hyphens, apostrophes, and spaces.
applicantMiddleName.maxlength: Your middle name must be 30 characters or fewer.

applicantLastName.pattern: Your last name can only include letters, hyphens, apostrophes, and spaces.
applicantLastName.maxlength: Your last name must be 30 characters or fewer.

applicantPhone.pattern: Enter a valid 10-digit U.S. phone number, like 2125551234.

applicantEmail.pattern: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.

applicantAddressZip.pattern: Enter a valid 5-digit ZIP code, like 20420.

relationshipToDecedent.required: Select your relationship to the deceased service member.

relationshipOtherDescription.required: Describe your relationship to the service member.
relationshipOtherDescription.maxlength: Your description must be 100 characters or fewer.

authorizationDocument.required: Upload your authorization document. If you are not the next of kin, you must provide written authorization to submit this request.
authorizationDocument.invalidFileType: The file you uploaded isn't an accepted format. Upload your authorization document as a PDF, JPG, or PNG file.
authorizationDocument.fileTooLarge: The file you uploaded is too large. Upload a file that's smaller than the size limit shown on the upload screen.
authorizationDocument.uploadFailed: We couldn't upload your file. Try again. If the problem continues, check that your file isn't corrupted or try a different format.

decedentFirstName.required: Enter the service member's first name as it appears on their service records.
decedentFirstName.pattern: The first name can only include letters, hyphens, apostrophes, and spaces.
decedentFirstName.maxlength: The first name must be 30 characters or fewer.

decedentMiddleName.pattern: The middle name can only include letters, hyphens, apostrophes, and spaces.
decedentMiddleName.maxlength: The middle name must be 30 characters or fewer.

decedentLastName.required: Enter the service member's last name as it appears on their service records.
decedentLastName.pattern: The last name can only include letters, hyphens, apostrophes, and spaces.
decedentLastName.maxlength: The last name must be 30 characters or fewer.

decedentSSN.required: Enter the service member's Social Security number.
decedentSSN.pattern: Enter a valid 9-digit Social Security number.

decedentDateOfBirth.required: Enter the service member's date of birth.
decedentDateOfBirth.invalidDate: Enter a valid date of birth. Use a real month, day, and year.
decedentDateOfBirth.futureDate: The date of birth can't be in the future.
decedentDateOfBirth.afterDeathDate: The date of birth must be before the date of death.

decedentDateOfDeath.required: Enter the service member's date of death.
decedentDateOfDeath.invalidDate: Enter a valid date of death. Use a real month, day, and year.
decedentDateOfDeath.futureDate: The date of death can't be in the future.
decedentDateOfDeath.beforeBirthDate: The date of death must be after the date of birth.

rankAtDeath.required: Enter the service member's military rank or rating at the time of death.
rankAtDeath.maxlength: The rank must be 50 characters or fewer.
rankAtDeath.pattern: The rank can only include letters, spaces, hyphens, and periods.

serviceEntryDate.required: Enter the date military service began.
serviceEntryDate.invalidDate: Enter a valid date military service began. Use a real month, day, and year.
serviceEntryDate.futureDate: The date military service began can't be in the future.
serviceEntryDate.afterDeathDate: The date military service began must be before the date of death.

cityOfDeath.required: Enter the city or location where the service member died.

countryOfDeath.required: Select the country where the service member died.

stateOfDeath.required: Select the state where the service member died.

cemeteryName.required: Enter the name of the cemetery.
cemeteryName.maxlength: The cemetery name must be 100 characters or fewer.

cemeteryStreet.required: Enter the cemetery's street address. The headstone or marker will be delivered to this address.

cemeteryCity.required: Enter the city where the cemetery is located.

cemeteryState.required: Select the state where the cemetery is located.

cemeteryZip.pattern: Enter a valid 5-digit ZIP code, like 20420.

cemeteryContactName.required: Enter the name of the contact person at the cemetery. This person will receive delivery of the headstone or marker.
cemeteryContactName.maxlength: The contact name must be 100 characters or fewer.

cemeteryContactPhone.required: Enter the cemetery contact's phone number.
cemeteryContactPhone.pattern: Enter a valid 10-digit phone number, like 2125551234.

existingMarkerPresent.required: Tell us whether there is already a headstone, marker, or monument at this grave.

markerType.required: Select the type of headstone or marker you're requesting.

emblemOfBelief.invalidOption: Select an emblem from the approved list, or select 'No emblem.' If you want an emblem that's not on the list, contact NCA before submitting.

personalInscription.maxlength: Your personal inscription is too long. Shorten it to fit within the character limit shown on this page.
personalInscription.pattern: Your inscription contains characters that aren't allowed. Use only letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and periods.

deathCertificateUpload.required: Upload a copy of the death certificate to continue.
deathCertificateUpload.invalidFileType: The file you uploaded isn't an accepted format. Upload the death certificate as a PDF, JPG, or PNG file.
deathCertificateUpload.fileTooLarge: The file you uploaded is too large. Upload a file that's smaller than the size limit shown on the upload screen.
deathCertificateUpload.uploadFailed: We couldn't upload your file. Try again. If the problem continues, try a different file format or check that your file isn't corrupted.
deathCertificateUpload.virusScanFailed: We couldn't verify this file is safe to upload. Try a different copy of the document.

ddForm1300Upload.required: Upload a copy of DD Form 1300 (Report of Casualty) to continue. If you don't have it yet, save your progress and return when you do.
ddForm1300Upload.invalidFileType: The file you uploaded isn't an accepted format. Upload DD Form 1300 as a PDF, JPG, or PNG file.
ddForm1300Upload.fileTooLarge: The file you uploaded is too large. Upload a file that's smaller than the size limit shown on the upload screen.
ddForm1300Upload.uploadFailed: We couldn't upload your file. Try again. If the problem continues, try a different file format or check that your file isn't corrupted.
ddForm1300Upload.virusScanFailed: We couldn't verify this file is safe to upload. Try a different copy of the document.

ngbForm22Upload.required: Upload a copy of NGB Form 22 or an equivalent Guard/Reserve service record to continue. If you don't have it yet, save your progress and return when you do.
ngbForm22Upload.invalidFileType: The file you uploaded isn't an accepted format. Upload your Guard/Reserve service record as a PDF, JPG, or PNG file.
ngbForm22Upload.fileTooLarge: The file you uploaded is too large. Upload a file that's smaller than the size limit shown on the upload screen.
ngbForm22Upload.uploadFailed: We couldn't upload your file. Try again. If the problem continues, try a different file format or check that your file isn't corrupted.
ngbForm22Upload.virusScanFailed: We couldn't verify this file is safe to upload. Try a different copy of the document.

additionalDocumentsUpload.invalidFileType: The file you uploaded isn't an accepted format. Upload additional documents as PDF, JPG, or PNG files.
additionalDocumentsUpload.fileTooLarge: The file you uploaded is too large. Upload a file that's smaller than the size limit shown on the upload screen.
additionalDocumentsUpload.uploadFailed: We couldn't upload your file. Try again. If the problem continues, try a different file format or check that your file isn't corrupted.
additionalDocumentsUpload.virusScanFailed: We couldn't verify this file is safe to upload. Try a different copy of the document.

certificationAttestation.required: You must check this box to certify that your information is correct before you can continue.

uspsAddressValidation.suggestionAvailable: We found a similar address. Review the suggestion below and select the address you want to use.
uspsAddressValidation.validationUnavailable: We couldn't verify this address right now. Make sure it's correct before continuing — the headstone or marker will be shipped to the cemetery address you enter.

eligibilityScreener.missingSelection: Answer all required questions before continuing.

chapterPage.missingRequiredFields: Some required information is missing or incorrect. Review the fields marked with an error and make corrections before continuing.

reviewAndSubmit.missingCertification: You must certify your information before submitting. Go back to the certification page and check the box.
reviewAndSubmit.generalError: We couldn't submit your request. Check that all required fields are filled in and try again.

submissionFailed.heading: We couldn't submit your request
submissionFailed.body: Something went wrong on our end. Your information was not submitted. Try again in a few minutes. If the problem continues, you can submit using the paper form.

submissionTimeout.heading: Your request is taking longer than expected
submissionTimeout.body: This is taking longer than usual. Your request may or may not have been submitted. Do not submit again right now. Wait a few minutes, then check your email for a confirmation. If you don't receive a confirmation within 24 hours, call NCA at 1-800-535-1117.

submissionDuplicate.heading: A request may already exist for this grave
submissionDuplicate.body: Our records show that a government headstone or marker may have already been requested or delivered for this grave. Submitting a duplicate request may delay processing. If you believe this is an error, call NCA at 1-800-535-1117 before submitting.

saveFailed.heading: We couldn't save your progress
saveFailed.body: Something went wrong and your progress wasn't saved. Try saving again. If the problem continues, don't close this tab — your answers are still here.

sessionTimeout.heading: Your session is about to expire
sessionTimeout.body: For your security, your session will expire in 5 minutes due to inactivity. Select 'Continue session' to keep working, or 'Save and sign out' to save your progress and come back later.

sessionExpired.heading: Your session has expired
sessionExpired.body: Your session expired due to inactivity. Sign back in to continue where you left off. Your progress was saved.

loadFailed.heading: We couldn't load your saved request
loadFailed.body: We had trouble loading your saved information. Try refreshing the page. If the problem continues, call the VA.gov help desk at 1-800-698-2411 (TTY: 711), Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET.

fileUpload.scanning: Checking your file for safety. This may take a moment.
fileUpload.uploadSuccess: Your file has been uploaded successfully.
fileUpload.removeFileConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this file? You'll need to upload it again if you change your mind.

wrongForm.heading: You may need a different form
wrongForm.body: VA Form 40-1330M is for service members who died while on active duty or qualifying National Guard or Reserve service. Because the service member you're requesting a marker for was discharged before they died, use VA Form 40-1330 instead.

notEligible.heading: This service member may not be eligible for this benefit through this form
notEligible.body: Based on your answers, this service member may not meet the qualifying criteria for a government headstone or marker through VA Form 40-1330M. We encourage you to contact NCA or a Veterans Service Organization for help understanding eligibility options.
notEligible.nceHours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. ET
